name: MMG Limited
summary: MMG Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the exploration, development, and mining of mineral properties. It operates through Las Bambas, Kinsevere, Khoemacau, Dugald River, and Rosebery segments. The company explore for copper, zinc, gold, silver, molybdenum, cobalt, and lead deposits. It holds a portfolio of projects in Peru, Australia, Botswana, and the Democratic Republic of Congo. MMG Limited was formerly known as Minmetals Resources Limited and changed its name to MMG Limited in September 2012. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Southbank, Australia. MMG Limited operates as a subsidiary of China Minmetals H.K. (Holdings) Limited.
